environment.note: The CLI ran from the published package bmad-plus@0.23.0 (npm registry), installed one level above the throwaway project.

setup: npm install --ignore-scripts <bmad-plus tarball> (one level above the project)
npx bmad-plus install --yes --lang en --packs core,design,memory --tools claude-code
cleanup: plain commands: ANSI escape sequences and carriage returns removed, trailing spaces trimmed, "npm notice run" lines dropped
interactive commands: raw pty output stored untouched

steps.cmd: npx bmad-plus intake record --intake .agents/skills/pack-design/intake.yaml --answers _bmad-output/design/intake.json --set surface_kind=landing --set "audience=Urban professionals who buy coffee most days" --set "job=Get a first-time visitor to open a loyalty card"
steps.output:
Recorded surface_kind, audience, job in _bmad-output/design/intake.json.
design-read (design): ready — 3 answered, 0 defaulted, 0 unknown, 10 not asked yet.
Ask next (at most 6 per message):
  - brand_assets [choice] Which brand assets exist already? None, a partial set (a logo and a colour or two), or a full kit (logo, palette, type, voice)? (choices: none, partial, full)
  - design_system [choice] Is a design system or component library already in use? (choices: none, shadcn, radix, mantine, material, fluent, carbon, polaris, other; default: "none")
  - aesthetic_family [choice] Does the brief imply an aesthetic family? Minimalist, brutalist, soft editorial, premium dense, or none in particular? (choices: minimalist, brutalist, soft-editorial, premium-dense, none; default: "none")
  - variance [number] Layout variance, from 1 (symmetric and safe) to 10 (asymmetric and bold)? Leave it open and Atelier sets it from the surface.
  - motion [number] Motion, from 1 (static) to 10 (choreographed)? Leave it open and Atelier sets it from the surface.
  - density [number] Density, from 1 (gallery-sparse) to 10 (cockpit-packed)? Leave it open and Atelier sets it from the surface.
